name: northeast_coordinates_v1
purpose: Public/obscured coordinates for the observations in northeast_train_dev_v1.csv, fetched independently. Does not modify that frozen file.
fetch_scope: Only the observation_uuid values already present in northeast_train_dev_v1.csv were queried -- no new observations were discovered or substituted, and the candidate pool was not expanded.
coordinate_policy: Only a public location is used: geoprivacy=private observations are always excluded (none exist in this dataset; the script hard-fails if that ever changes). Obscured coordinates ARE included -- iNaturalist's obscuring displaces a location by roughly 20-25km, well inside the geo index's 1-degree (~111km) grid cell, so no precision is lost at that resolution for this use. Missing or unrecoverable coordinates are left absent, never inferred or estimated.
